headline: Kid Cudi just randomly spawned in during Speed’s stream at the Apple event 😂😂😭 Via: App
body: Kid Cudi just randomly spawned in during Speed’s stream at the Apple event 😂😂😭 Via: Apple’s “Surprise and Shine” event just wrapped. First September keynote with John Ternus as CEO. They opened with the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. A20 Pro on 2nm. Variable-aperture 48MP camera. Smaller Dynamic Island. Longest battery Apple’s ever put in a phone. Colors: black, silver, glacier, burgundy. Pro starts at $1,199. Pro Max at $1,299. Pre-order September 12. In stores September 18. Regular iPhone 18 didn’t drop. That’s spring 2027. Then the “one more thing.” First foldable iPhone. It’s called iPhone Duo. 5.4-inch cover screen, 7.6-inch inner display. Starts at $1,999. Pre-orders October 16. Ships October 23. Star White and Night Sky. They also dropped AirPods 5, Apple Watch Series 12, and Watch Ultra 4, plus the next wave of Apple Intelligence and Siri on iOS 27. Biggest hardware day Apple’s had in years. New CEO. New Pro phones. First foldable.

source_caption_text:
Kid Cudi just randomly spawned in during Speed’s stream at the Apple event 😂😂😭
Via: @ishowspeed 

Apple’s “Surprise and Shine” event just wrapped. First September keynote with John Ternus as CEO.

They opened with the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. A20 Pro on 2nm. Variable-aperture 48MP camera. Smaller Dynamic Island. Longest battery Apple’s ever put in a phone. Colors: black, silver, glacier, burgundy. Pro starts at $1,199. Pro Max at $1,299. Pre-order September 12. In stores September 18. Regular iPhone 18 didn’t drop. That’s spring 2027.

Then the “one more thing.” First foldable iPhone. It’s called iPhone Duo. 5.4-inch cover screen, 7.6-inch inner display. Starts at $1,999. Pre-orders October 16. Ships October 23. Star White and Night Sky.

They also dropped AirPods 5, Apple Watch Series 12, and Watch Ultra 4, plus the next wave of Apple Intelligence and Siri on iOS 27.
Biggest hardware day Apple’s had in years. New CEO. New Pro phones. First foldable.
